summary: Betterware de Mexico filed a Form 6-K furnishing a free English translation of the first call to an Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting set for October 16, 2026, at its Guadalajara domicile, alongside a proxy form. The agenda covers only approval of dividend payments and appointment of special delegates to formalize resolutions. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is a routine meeting notice, so the special-situations classification is None; watch for the declared dividend amount and record date once approved.
